Pralhad Joshi Appointed Education Minister After Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns

Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned as the Union Minister for Education. Pralhad Joshi, currently the Union Minister for Food and Consumer Affairs, has been given the additional charge of the Education Ministry. Joshi, a five-time Member of Parliament, stated he would fulfill the responsibilities with dedication. Several outlets provided biographical details on Joshi, highlighting his political journey and educational background.
